h1: The “Premium” design package — extended interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: The “Premium” design package — extended interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: “Premium” is a design project with maximum detail: a full set of working drawings, as in “Basic”, plus wall elevations for every room, detail drawings and sections, specifications, and quantity calculations for the main materials.
Also included: up to two full rounds of revisions to the 3D visualizations and two material-selection trips with the designer.
A package for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces where precise execution matters and you want as few questions as possible to come up during the renovation.
Before design work begins, the key dimensions of the rooms are recorded, along with the location of walls, window and door openings, utilities, and other architectural elements.
The measured floor plan becomes the foundation for developing the layout, technical documentation, and 3D visualizations.
A functional layout is developed showing the placement of furniture, plumbing fixtures, and key interior elements.
Room dimensions, ease of movement, ergonomics, storage systems, and the ways the space will be used day to day are all taken into account.
Where necessary, plans are prepared for demolishing existing structures and building new partitions.
The exact locations of plumbing fixtures and the required utility connection points are determined.
Bathrooms, guest toilets, kitchens, laundry rooms, and other spaces that require plumbing connections are worked out in detail.
Where necessary, a layout of underfloor heating zones is developed, taking into account the furniture, plumbing fixtures, and specifics of the floor plan.
A plan is developed showing the location of outlets, electrical connection points, and appliance connections.
The electrical layout is designed around the future arrangement of furniture, the kitchen, TVs, workspaces, and other equipment.
The location of switches and the lighting control scenarios are determined.
A plan is developed showing the placement of general and decorative light sources.
The project may include ceiling fixtures, track systems, pendant lights, wall sconces, LED strip lighting, and other solutions.
A plan of the ceiling structures is developed, taking into account lighting, built-in elements, and the architecture of the space.
The types and boundaries of floor coverings, laying directions, and transitions between materials are defined.
This makes it possible to agree in advance on the use of parquet, engineered wood flooring, ceramic tile, porcelain tile, and other floor coverings.
Extended wall elevations are prepared for every room, not just for the kitchen and bathrooms as in the “Basic” package.
The elevations may show furniture, plumbing fixtures, tile, decorative panels, outlets, light fixtures, built-in elements, and other important details.
For complex interior solutions, additional detail drawings, cross-sections, and sectional views are prepared.

blocks.text: 13. Specifications and quantity calculations for the main materials

parts.html: The project includes specifications and information on the main finishing materials called for by the approved concept.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are created for each main room.
They let you see the future interior in advance and evaluate how materials, furniture, lighting, colors, textiles, and decorative elements work together.
“Premium” includes up to two full rounds of revisions to the concept (“Basic” includes one).
What sets “Premium” apart is the level of technical detail: in addition to standard working drawings, the project includes extended wall elevations, detail drawings, sections, and specifications.
This is especially important if the interior has a lot of custom furniture, decorative panels, non-standard ceilings, complex junctions between materials, and built-in elements.
The more detailed the technical documentation, the fewer decisions have to be made on site during the renovation.

blocks.text: Two material-selection trips with the designer

parts.html: The package includes two material-selection trips with the designer.
During these trips, you can approve actual samples of tile, flooring, paint, decorative materials, and other interior elements.
As a result, the finished interior is closer to the approved 3D visualizations, and the risk of unsuccessful material combinations on site is lower.

The package is suitable for apartments in new developments, apartments in existing buildings, private houses, condos, investment properties, offices, beauty salons, stores, showrooms, and other commercial spaces.
It is especially well suited to properties with complex architecture, a large amount of built-in furniture, non-standard finishing solutions, and high demands on the quality of execution.

If you need the most thoroughly developed project possible with detailed documentation for the crew, the interior has many bespoke solutions, or you want as few questions as possible to come up during the renovation.
And also if detailed work on materials, more revisions to the visualizations, and the designer’s help in choosing finishes matter to you.

A detailed design project: a layout with furniture arrangement, 3D visualizations, an extended set of drawings with wall elevations, detail drawings, and sections, specifications, and quantity calculations for the main materials.
Plus up to two full rounds of revisions to the visualizations and two material-selection trips with the designer.
€50/m²
Minimum package price: €2,500.
The final cost depends on the floor area of the property, the number of rooms, the complexity of the architectural and interior solutions, and the scope of technical documentation required.
“Basic” (€35–45/m²) is a complete design project with the core set of working drawings for the renovation.

“Premium” (€50/m²) adds wall elevations for every room, detail drawings and sections, extended specifications and material calculations, up to two full rounds of revisions to the visualizations instead of one, and two material-selection trips with the designer.
If the property is complex or precise execution is important to you, “Premium” will better prepare the project for construction work.

You can add design supervision, a detailed renovation cost estimate, furnishing and procurement (furniture, lighting, decor), and the design and manufacture of custom furniture — kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets — with delivery and installation, as well as a turnkey renovation. That way, after the design stage you continue working with a single contractor.

blocks.text: Interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs residential and commercial interiors: layout, visualization, working documentation, custom furniture, and implementation.
We work primarily in Bratislava and Vienna, as well as in other European cities and in the USA.
If you need the most detailed project possible, with extended documentation and the designer’s support as you prepare for the renovation, choose “Premium”.
